status: WIP mask exploration; not production, not hair truth
broad_roi: manual_artifact_polygons_v2 covers whole cuff band and hand; includes adjacent legal hair

seed_rules.skin: R-G>=2, R-B>=2, R>165, G>115, alpha>12 within broad hand ROI
seed_rules.cuff_teal: G-R>=6, -16<=B-G<=28, G<250, alpha>12 within cuff ROI
seed_rules.cuff_neutral: near-white cuff candidates only within 12px of cyan seeds
seed_rules.hand_neutral: near-neutral palm pixels only within 18px of warm skin seeds
seed_rules.outline: dark pixels within 2px of color seeds and broad ROI; mask expanded 1px for anti-alias edge

warning: Heuristics locate candidate foreign pixels; warm hair highlights or neutral hair may be false positives. Inspect red overlay at native/zoom before using. Clear-only output is a hole diagnostic, not an acceptable repair.
